# French Food Tour Paris — frenchfoodtour.com

## About

French Food Tour is an intimate food and wine tour in Montmartre, Paris, led by Imrane — a former food and beverage professional with experience at Michelin-starred kitchens and two world top-10 restaurants.

The tour runs in Montmartre (18th arrondissement, Paris). Groups are capped at 8 guests. All food and drink is included. The experience lasts approximately 3 hours and covers 7 stops with 15 tastings.

## Guide

- **Name**: Imrane
- **Background**: Former floor manager at Michelin-starred restaurants and two world top-10 establishments. Has lived and worked in Montmartre for over a decade.
- **Languages**: English, French
- **About page**: https://www.frenchfoodtour.com/about

## The Tour

- **Name**: Montmartre Food & Wine Tour
- **Location**: Montmartre, Paris 75018, France (meeting point: Anvers metro station)
- **Duration**: ~3 hours
- **Group size**: Maximum 8 guests
- **Price**: €115/adult, €95/child
- **Included**: 15 tastings — cheese, wine, charcuterie, oysters, chocolate, bread/pastries, restaurant finale
- **Stops**: Fromagerie, boulangerie, butcher, seafood stop, artisan chocolatier, restaurant
- **Tour page**: https://www.frenchfoodtour.com/food-tour
- **Book**: https://www.frenchfoodtour.com/book

## Private Tours

Private and group food tours are available for couples, families, corporate teams, and special occasions. Fully customised, exclusively for your group.

- **Private tours page**: https://www.frenchfoodtour.com/private-tours
